thread.title: OIKOS Journey Drive Evidence Exhibition and Canonical Asset Compiler
thread.purpose: Establish Google Drive as the first governed intake test for an R&D tax audit visual research exhibition, verify write authority, create a classification structure, inventory evidence, and define a reusable Canonical Asset Compiler for later Drive, S3, GitHub, chat, PDF and other-source ingestion.

source_thread_reference.basis: No platform-native conversation ID was exposed.

classification.reason: Drive writes and classification folders are REAL with connector receipts. Recursive crawl, manifests, file movement, hashes, S3/CloudFront, compiler implementation, Pen operator execution and runtime readback are incomplete.

completed_work.result: Initial 403 insufficientParentPermissions; after permission change child creation succeeded.
Assets span at least 2026-03-24 to 2026-07-18, including PNG, WebP, HEIF and PDF. No source files moved or renamed.
TML-4PM/the-pen, main branch, private, connector push/admin authority
README and global/ENFORCEMENT_LIVE.md say normal canonical writes use MCP bridge fn_github_push; connector write is an explicit user-directed exception and is not runtime execution.

assumptions: The connector inventory may be top-level rather than a complete recursive crawl.
Modified timestamps support chronology but do not prove research causality.
Same-size assets are probable duplicates but require hashes or content comparison.
Canonical Asset Compiler is proposed, not implemented.
open_commitments: Recursively crawl the entire OIKOS Journey folder.
Create the canonical asset register with Drive IDs, names, URLs, MIME types, sizes, dates, parents and permissions.
Hash eligible assets and detect exact/perceptual duplicates.
Classify by research stream, phase, evidence type and publication state.
Construct chronology and movement/rename plan before moving files.
Add other Drive folders, S3, GitHub, chats, PDFs and additional sources through the same provider-neutral contract.
Provision private S3/CloudFront publication path when AWS execution is available.
Implement and run Canonical Asset Compiler v0.1.
Execute tools/thread_runtime_submit.py and independently read back local spool or S3.
blockers_and_missing_evidence: No tools/thread_runtime_submit.py execution receipt in this session.
No S3 identity, write or readback receipt.
No complete recursive Drive crawl receipt.
No asset hashes, canonical manifest or movement ledger.
Drive currently exposes anyone-with-link writer permission, too broad for audit evidence.
